correctness.rationale: The 16 vertices are F_2^4 and graph edges are the five nonzero XOR steps 1,2,4,8,15. The closed-neighborhood avoidance test is exactly the dominance criterion for complement sets. Independently implemented exhaustive computation verified all 65,536 masks; 53,730 nonempty faces, the complete 12-entry f-vector, 368 facets in dimensions 9/10/11, 26,799 disjoint matching pairs under the assigned pivot order, exactly one critical zero-cell and 131 critical nine-faces, all 401,088 nonempty Hasse covers, and a Kahn topological sort of all 53,730 nodes. Forman discrete Morse theory then gives a CW model with one point and 131 nine-cells; all attaching maps to a point are constant, hence the integral wedge of 131 S^9. Independently computed alpha=5 from all 65,536 subsets, tau=11 and Euler characteristic -130; vertex cover bound is strict (8+2<11). The independent face-set and matching SHA-256 fingerprints exactly match the source verification output. The exact eight Git blob SHAs produce the assigned source-tree SHA.
